title: Data
description: Create and restore complete backups of Knovum's managed data.
tasksActive: Finish or cancel active tasks before starting data maintenance.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Creates a consistent archive while Knovum restarts in maintenance mode.
backup.contentsDescription: Includes Spaces, usage history, preferences, managed Space and voice assets, and installed extensions. Credentials, downloaded models, runtimes, caches, and logs are excluded.
backup.confirmTitle: Restart Knovum to create this backup?
backup.confirmDescription: Knovum will save pending changes, restart, create the selected backup before opening its databases, then continue startup. Active Runs and processing jobs must finish or be cancelled first.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.description: Validates the complete archive before replacing managed data, with rollback if publication fails. Full backups restore only to the same Knovum data location; use Space packages to move Spaces between installations.
restore.credentialsDescription: Restore removes current saved credentials to prevent old authorization from matching restored records. Configure provider and connector credentials again afterward.
restore.confirmTitle: Restart Knovum and restore this backup?
restore.confirmDescription: Knovum will save pending changes and restart. The archive must match this release exactly. Current managed data remains available for rollback until restoration succeeds.

receipt.credentials: Credentials were not included. Configure provider and connector credentials again before using them.
receipt.exclusions: Credentials, downloaded models, runtimes, caches, and logs were excluded.
receipt.readFailed: Maintenance result could not be read
receipt.acknowledgeFailed: Maintenance result could not be dismissed
